metadata.title: Email Application Notification SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing send-only application-generated email using the Email Notification Gateway pattern.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, and operational baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Outbound-only email capability used by applications to deliver notifications, alerts, and transactional messages to institutional recipients.

information-type.title: Notification Message Content
information-type.description: Application-generated message bodies, headers, and templated content.

information-type.title: Notification Metadata
information-type.description: Message identifiers, timestamps, sender application identity, routing and delivery status.

information-type.title: Notification Audit Events
information-type.description: Audit records of message submission, policy enforcement, throttling, and delivery results.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Application Email – Send‑Only inherits all platform trust, transport security, monitoring, and resilience guarantees.

props.name: primary-pattern
props.remarks: This SSPP implements the Email Notification Gateway pattern.

props.name: usage-intent
props.remarks: This service is strictly limited to application-generated notifications and transactional messaging.

props.name: directionality
props.remarks: This service does not receive, process, or store inbound email.

props.name: reply-capability
props.remarks: Replies are not supported, monitored, or processed.

props.name: sender-identity-model
props.remarks: All sender identities MUST use a no-reply naming convention (e.g., no-reply@).

props.name: subdomain-isolation
props.remarks: Send-only application email MUST use a dedicated subdomain with isolated SPF, DKIM, and DMARC policy.

props.name: dmarc-policy
props.remarks: Dedicated subdomain MUST enforce a strict DMARC policy aligned with institutional standards.

props.name: recipient-scope
props.remarks: Messages MAY be sent only to institutional email addresses. External recipients are prohibited.

props.name: recipient-validation
props.remarks: Recipients MUST be validated against authoritative institutional identity or directory systems.

props.name: delegation
props.remarks: Delegated Send-As or Send-On-Behalf is not permitted for application send-only email.

props.name: automation-scope
props.remarks: Message generation is controlled exclusively by application logic; human interaction is not permitted.

props.name: volume-profile
props.remarks: Message volume is constrained to expected notification rates and subject to throttling.

props.name: external-forwarding
props.remarks: Forwarding rules do not apply and cannot be configured.

props.name: data-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Application send-only email MUST NOT include information classified above Level 2.

props.name: information-use-constraint
props.remarks: Notification email is transient and must not be relied upon for record storage or retrieval.

props.name: security-enforcement-scope
props.remarks: Messages may be filtered, throttled, suppressed, or recalled if abuse or compromise is detected.

props.name: auditability
props.remarks: All notification messages MUST be auditable and attributable to the originating application identity.

system-implementation.remarks: The service operates as a one-way notification pipeline with strict sender identity, recipient validation, and abuse prevention.

components.title: Application Email Notification Gateway
components.description: Send-only email gateway enforcing identity, policy, throttling, and monitoring for application notifications.

roles.title: Application Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable for notification content, templates, and appropriate use of the send-only email capability.

control-implementation.remarks: All applicable controls are satisfied through Secure Email Platform SSPP and Email Notification Gateway pattern. No standalone controls are implemented in this SSPP.
